description: No defined processes for protecting stored account data.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Payment processors and service providers E-commerce platforms and merchants Database systems containing payment card data Data transmission channels and APIs

related_controls: 3.1 Processes and mechanisms for protecting stored account data are defined and understood
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review organizational documentation for data protection policies and procedures. Check for absence of documented processes covering data storage security, retention policies, and protection mechanisms. Verify whether security controls for stored cardholder data are documented and understood by personnel handling payment card information.
